1. **Simulate data:**

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Simulation of seven datasets for DBSCAN parameter exploration

set.seed(123)
library(MASS)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(dbscan)

n <- 200

# 1. High‐separation spherical clusters
data_dem <- rbind(
  mvrnorm(n/2, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = diag(2)),
  mvrnorm(n/2, mu = c(3, 3), Sigma = diag(2))
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble(.name_repair = ~c("x","y"))
```

2. **Applying hierarchical clustering:**

```{r}
# can pre-calculate distance matrix
dist_mat <- dist(
  data_dem,
  # choose distance metric
  method = "manhattan"
)
# hierarchical clustering
hclust_obj <- hclust(dist(data_dem), method = "ward.D2")
```
